dataset_story: The CERT Insider Threat dataset provides a multi-source collection of synthetic enterprise activity logs. It is used in AURA to model trust decay and internal employee risk escalation.
aura_purpose: Used to model trust decay, privilege escalation, and anomalous employee behavior patterns.

citation.text: Glasser, J., & Lindauer, B. (2013). Bridging the gap: A pragmatic approach to generating insider threat data. IEEE Security and Privacy Workshops.

pc.description: Computer identifier where the activity occurred

activity.description: Action performed (Logon, Logoff, Connect, Disconnect, etc.)
